title: Dig Dug
summary: Your original Commodore 64 edition, preserved for a future native Mac rewrite.
notes: Original archive preserved. No native implementation is available yet.
Contains a 16647-byte DIGDUG.T64 plus an NFO; no high-level game source is present.
A tape container preserves program data but does not specify the original visual/audio/input behavior by itself.
keyboard: Planned: keyboard and trackpad bindings after original control behavior is documented.
controller: Planned: Xbox / extended gamepad mapping. Physical controller validation remains required.
